description_en: Modify the Trail configuration information for the AK
description_zh: 修改多云接入的审计日志（ActionTrail）接入配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun sas modify-cloud-vendor-trial-config --auth-id 2300 --vendor Tencent --auth-info sqsRegion_:_us-west-2_,_sqsQueueName_:_0000 --delete-trail true --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCloudVendorTrialConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the audit log configuration to be modified.
> The ID can be queried via [DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~)
parameters.help_zh:
修改的审计日志配置的ID。
> ID通过[DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~)查询
parameters.name: auth_id

parameters.help_en:
Cloud asset vendor. Values:

- **Tencent**: Tencent Cloud
- **AWS**: AWS
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：

- **Tencent**：腾讯云
- **AWS**：AWS
parameters.name: vendor

parameters.help_en:
Enter the multi-cloud configuration information:
- AWS: parameters sqsQueueName, sqsRegion
- Tencent: parameters kafkaUserName, kafkaBootstrapServers, kafkaTopic
parameters.help_zh:
输入多云配置信息：
- AWS：入参 sqsQueueName、sqsRegion
- Tencent：入参 kafkaUserName、kafkaBootstrapServers、kafkaTopic
parameters.name: auth_info

parameters.help_en:
Whether to delete this audit log configuration:
- true: Delete
- false: Do not delete
parameters.help_zh:
是否删除此审计日志配置：
- true：删除
- false：不删除
parameters.name: delete_trail
